contract.note: The plain reading is fair: adjacent-day demonstrations, experimental systems, broadly similar technology and factual errors, and prominent contrasting reception. Neither equal performance nor unanimous coverage is implied.

evidence.note: Microsoft's dated disclosure establishes its event, language-model technology, restricted preview and acknowledged errors. It is company evidence, not an independent readiness assessment.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes adjacent-day presentations, experimental access, comparable language-model tools, factual-error problems and prominent contrasting coverage. Criticism of Bing and praise for its integration qualify the comparison without refuting it. The evidence does not establish equal accuracy or unanimous reception, neither of which the fair plain-reading contract requires.
